# Best 3-in-1 Qi2 charging stands for iPhone, Apple Watch and AirPods

**My top pick is the Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand.** WIRED named it Best Overall after testing 30+ models. It charges the iPhone at up to 15W, fast-charges an Apple Watch Series 7 or newer, and has an AirPods pad on the base. The iPhone pad tilts and works in landscape for StandBy mode. The 36W power supply is included, and it has a 2-year warranty. WIRED listed it at $109, with $98 shown as a discount and $80-90 at Amazon and Best Buy. [Shop links in WIRED's guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/)

## Other good options

| Need | Pick | Price (per WIRED) | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Fastest | Nomad Stand One Max | $169 | Qi2 25W for the iPhone. It has a heavy base and a 6.6 ft cable, but no power adapter is included. You need a 40W one, such as Nomad's 40W Slim Adapter ($25). |
| Budget | ESR Qi2 3-in-1 Wireless Charging Station | about $40 (listed $80) | Qi2-certified at 15W, and it includes a charger and cable. The Apple Watch puck detaches. It has a 1-year warranty. |
| Sleeping with it nearby | Nimble Podium 3-in-1 | $130 | Lies flat so screens stay out of sight, or pops up for StandBy. It supports Qi2 25W, but its Apple Watch charging is slow, so it's best overnight. |
| Travel and desk | Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable (Qi2 25W) | $129.99 | Macworld found it the tallest and most adjustable foldable stand. It includes a 45W adapter with UK and EU plugs. It is heavier, at 399g, than rival foldables. [Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html) |
| Compact travel | Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (Qi2) | about $80 (listed $110) | Folds slim and charges at 15W. It includes a 40W adapter and has a 2-year warranty. [WIRED travel guide](https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/) |

WIRED's travel guide also covers the ESR CryoBoost (25W, $100) and Journey Aria ($130, with a bedside light).

## Which should you get?
- **Most people:** Belkin. WIRED notes that 25W charging makes little difference if you charge overnight.
- **Fast top-ups on an iPhone 16 or 17:** Nomad Stand One Max or Satechi 25W. Macworld notes that Qi2 25W only applies to the iPhone 16 and 17 series.
- **Tight budget:** ESR.

## Before you buy
- Your AirPods case needs to support wireless charging.
- Apple Watch fast charging needs a Series 7 or newer.
- Prices are from WIRED's September 2026 update and may have changed, so check the current price at checkout.
